title: Add website favicon, Apple touch icon, and root metadata
body: Fix the missing website favicon by adding `website/app/icon.svg` (standalone Flight Director's Console `AgbMark` vector icon), `website/app/apple-icon.tsx` (`180x180` PNG Apple Touch Icon via `next/og`), `website/app/favicon.ico` (`32x32` ICO for legacy `/favicon.ico` requests), and root `metadata` in `website/app/layout.tsx`.
